text: In 1929 the Duc de Richleau finds [a pentagram and strange markings|images|holy and occult objects] in the house of his protégé Simon Aron and deduces that he has fallen in with [a devil-worshipping cult|threat|the devil and dark gods]. With his friend Rex Van Ryn he snatches Simon and Tanith from a May Day rite on Salisbury Plain, where the Devil appears as the Goat of Mendes. The cult leader Mocata besieges them through a night of black magic, conjuring an Angel of Death that, [once summoned, must take a life|rules|calling it brings it], and [kidnaps the Eatons' young daughter Peggy|who_suffers|young children].
